name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms supported, hands beyond the edge and thumbs pointing up around the dumbbell handles.
Tilt your hands upward from the wrists to lift the thumb ends of the dumbbells.
Lower the thumb ends slowly through a comfortable range.
tips: Keep the little-finger side of each forearm planted on the bench.
Keep the handle aligned with your forearm as you lift the thumb side of your hand.
